## Constraints

### Must

- Keep campaign intent, transcript words and visual proof visibly connected.
- Support default, loading, empty, error, success and 390px states.
- Use one ClipFactory blue for actions, source markers, focus and playheads; reserve green for verified success.
- Preserve source and brief context when billing blocks analysis.

### Avoid

- Generic metric-card dashboards before first value.
- Purple-blue mesh heroes and glassmorphism on every surface.
- Fake progress percentages, uploads, retries or subscription portal actions.
- `transition-all`, routine entrance animation and decorative infinite motion.

## Decisions

- Edit Axis is the canonical landing; one Apple Pro direction organizes the Source Thread.
- Signal Timeline is the canonical processing direction; Continuity and Manuscript remain temporary lab references only.
- Account to guided brief to source to first-trial processing to locked teaser to contextual paywall to unlocked result to workspace sequence.
- The A-to-Z local journey is an interactive QA prototype; production needs a bounded first-job trial and gated outputs before the paywall can honestly move after processing.
- Radix Dialog and Tabs for focus and keyboard behavior.
- Three semantic campaign chapters rather than seven flat fields.
- Checkout return remains confirmation-pending until subscription data is active.
